name: pingidentity
description: Agent plugins for Ping Identity — human-facing quickstart, agent-facing cross-portfolio dispatcher, and product-specific plugins for autonomous agentic workflows.

plugins.name: ping-identity-quickstart
plugins.description: Human-facing map of Ping Identity resources. Orients users, detects platform, and points to the right resource — docs, portal, marketplace, GitHub, tooling. Advisory only.

plugins.name: ping-identity
plugins.description: Cross-portfolio agent plugin for Ping Identity. Hosts the ping-identity foundations skill (portfolio orientation and routing) with reference topics covering the portfolio, solutions, and application-integration concepts. Pair with product plugins for implementation.

plugins.name: ping-identity-pingone
plugins.description: App-integration guidance for connecting web, mobile, and backend applications to a PingOne environment (SDK wiring, OIDC/PKCE, CORS, Worker applications), DaVinci flow design guidance for building flows (registration, login, MFA, step-up, passkeys), live-MCP-backed troubleshooting for DaVinci flow executions, and audit-event investigation for platform operations.

plugins.name: ping-identity-pingone-aic
plugins.description: Journey design and build guidance for PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (AIC) journeys and PingAM authentication trees — node selection, wiring invariants, risk, MFA, passkey, and recovery journeys — plus app-integration guidance for connecting applications to AIC (Journey modules, journey client, OIDC/PKCE, tenant CORS), with MCP-backed journey creation where connected.

plugins.name: ping-orchestration-sdks
plugins.description: Companion SDK skills for deep client-side integration — Android (Kotlin), iOS (Swift), and React/JavaScript SDK scaffolding, DaVinci collector rendering, Journey callbacks, and ForgeRock-to-Ping migration.
